title: brief_lint's CI run never lints the live rosters in dev/programme/rosters/ (66 live groups; 3 rotted citations)
claim: The no-argument run of tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs (tests.yml `briefs`) lints 1 roster file, .claude/workflows/wave-3l-groups.json (1 live group), and not dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (52 live groups) or wave-r9-groups.json (14): an unresolvable path appended to a live brief there leaves TOTAL at 0, the same edit in wave-3l moves it to 1, and the r10 roster already carries 3 path:line errors that only a named-file run prints.
mechanism: main() takes `files = workflowFiles(ROSTER_FILE_RE)`, which lists .claude/workflows/ and dev/programme/carries/ only; ROSTERS_DIR is read by rosterIssues (the issue index) but never linted. roster_edit.py's write gate lints the roster by name but demotes every error the base already has to `WARN pre-existing, re-pin owed`, so a citation that rots after its write is refused by nothing.

evidence.unit: live roster files in ROSTERS_DIR the CI run does not lint (gap_arms_unmoved=2 of 2; named_wave_r10_groups_errors=3; controls_fired=3 of 3)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, other seats running; counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: brief_lint.mjs main(): `? workflowFiles(ROSTER_FILE_RE)` -> also list ROSTERS_DIR's wave-*-groups.json (harness --perturb)
perturbation.observed_value: rosters_linted 1 -> 3; null TOTAL 0 -> 3; gap_r10_path 0 -> 4, gap_r9_path 0 -> 4; live_rosters_in_rosters_dir_unlinted 2 -> 0

metric_definition: Per arm, the TOTAL error count of brief_lint.mjs's no-argument run in a worktree of the baseline, and the roster files whose `== file ==` header that run prints.
phenomenon_property: Every roster file holding a live (non-done) group is linted by the required no-argument brief_lint run, so a citation that stops resolving in any live brief turns `briefs` red.
seam_rule: git ls-files '*wave-*-groups.json' | grep -v fixtures (each file not printed under `== ... ==` by `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs`)

null_control.note: the same probe edit in the one roster the run reads, and a playbook rename, each turn the run red, so the unmoved gap arms are the input list, not a dead linter

reproduction_steps: node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs  (in a full checkout: TOTAL 0 across 40 files; no dev/programme/rosters header)
node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json  (TOTAL 3: R10-RELAY-NOBODY-STALL path:line anchors moved)
proposed_fix_scope: brief_lint.mjs main() lints ROSTERS_DIR rosters on the no-argument run (one line; a named r10 run measured about 5 s here, provisional), the 3 rotted R10-RELAY-NOBODY-STALL anchors re-pinned in the same pull request, and brief-citations.md's first sentence names the roster directory. Mechanisation (D11.M5): this replaces the manual 're-pin owed' WARN that roster_edit.py prints with a refusal; cost one line of code, no policy line.
